remarks:
Escape to your own private retreat with this extraordinary 105-acre property in historic French Creek, New York, located just over the mountain from the renowned Peak'n Peak Resort and Golf Course. Offering breathtaking panoramic valley views, approximately 1,840 feet of frontage along scenic French Creek, and endless opportunities for outdoor recreation, this one-of-a-kind property is a nature lover's dream.

The recently built main residence showcases stunning craftsmanship with soaring 20-foot wood ceilings, a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone wood-burning fireplace, and a thoughtfully designed country kitchen complete with a hidden pantry and copper sink. The home offers two bedrooms on the lower level, a spacious full bath, an additional bathroom on the main floor and bonus room that could be a bedroom plus loft space, and a large 3/4 wrap around porch perfect for taking in the incredible views.

A charming newly constructed cottage, surrounded by beautiful flowers and open fields, provides excellent income as an Airbnb or use for your own private guest house. The cottage includes a spacious bedroom, cozy living room, unique kitchen, and full bath.

Explore wooded trails lined with walnut, pine, oak, and maple trees, perfect for hiking, snowmobiling, and even skiing right on your own land. The property connects to extensive tri-state trail systems, providing access to hundreds of miles of scenic adventures.

The impressive barn features a newer roof, chicken coop, deck, and picnic pavilion, offering ample space for horses, goats, and other livestock. Two picturesque ponds enhance the property's beauty, including one with its own private beach area, creating the perfect setting for relaxation and recreation.

With multiple potential building sites, abundant natural beauty, and unmatched privacy, this remarkable property offers endless possibilities as a primary residence, vacation retreat, recreational property, hobby farm, or investment opportunity. A truly rare offering in Western New York.
